name: Tennis Ball
summary: Two separate optic yellow-green felt halves, bounded by a closed two-lobed S seam. The off-white rubber band is approximately 4.5 mm wide, with latitude offsets corrected for seam slope, recessed up to 0.25 mm. Felt is high-roughness with a baked grain normal map and exported sheen.
description: Two separate optic yellow-green felt halves, bounded by a closed two-lobed S seam. The off-white rubber band is approximately 4.5 mm wide, with latitude offsets corrected for seam slope, recessed up to 0.25 mm. Felt is high-roughness with a baked grain normal map and exported sheen. Static visual asset; no physics.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python surface meshes and capped seam/thread tubes; Cycles-baked procedural tangent-space normal map. No external assets or markings.

display.origin: Actual floor contact point under the horizontally centred exported bounds

accuracy_notes: ITF Rules of Tennis 2026, Appendix I, Type 2: diameter 65.4–68.6 mm; midpoint 67.0 mm. The spherical two-lobed curve approximates a generic tennis seam. Felt fibers are normal detail, without individual silhouette hairs. Band width uses a local tangent approximation to a 4.5 mm spherical offset. Measured extents include raised seams/threads; nominal diameter describes the skin. Fine grain is normal detail only. Source: https://www.itftennis.com/media/7221/2026-rules-of-tennis-english.pdf

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and baked texture; no external models, fonts, images or logos.
